title: Third 100 high-machine candidates: facsimile headword/boundary review
provenance_note: AI-assisted visual collation against the supplied Steffel facsimile. This batch spans the end of the German→Rarámuri dictionary and the beginning of the Rarámuri→German dictionary. Review covers headword presence, article-start boundary and exact printed page only; it is not linguistic validation and does not by itself constitute complete diplomatic transcription.

RHD-S1809-01163.note: “Badſtube” is a cross-reference subline inside the article Schwitzstube (“ſ. Badſtube”), not an independent article start.

RHD-S1809-01233.note: OCR candidate is the running header “Wörterbuch” on printed p. 343, not a lexicographic article.

RHD-S1809-01569.note: “Gott!” completes the phrase “Wollte Gott!” inside the article Wünſchen; it is not a new article.

RHD-S1809-01646.note: “Thun oder Machen” is explanatory German prose within Ajóruje and describes the function of the auxiliary ruje; not a Rarámuri headword.
